title: LADM LA_SpatialSource
description: Source with spatial reference representing a survey event (field measurement campaign). Contains the survey procedure, raw/adjusted measurements as SurveyPoints, and attached files via the STAC-inspired assets map. Only final adjusted coordinates are stored in SurveyPoints; raw field observations, sketches, and auxiliary measurements are in assets. Points of type 'boundary' and 'building' become registered LA_Point objects after cadastral acceptance; 'auxiliary' and 'control' points remain only in the spatial source.

allOf.$comment: INHERITANCE: Inherits everything from the abstract LA_Source
EXTENSIONS: Specific properties for Spatial Source

sourceType.description: Discriminator identifying this as a Spatial Source

measurements.description: Final adjusted survey points. 'boundary' and 'building' types become registered LA_Point objects after acceptance. 'auxiliary' and 'control' types are stored only in the spatial source for context and quality verification.

assets.description: Survey files attached to this source. Common roles: 'sketch' (field sketch PDF), 'data' (adjusted coordinates file), 'gnss-log' (raw RINEX), 'report' (survey report).

SurveyPoint.description: A single measured point from the survey. Final adjusted coordinates only — raw field observations are in the assets. 'boundary' and 'building' points will become registered LA_Point objects after acceptance; 'auxiliary' and 'control' points remain only in the spatial source.

localId.description: Local identifier within this survey (e.g. 'PT-001'). Used to cross-reference points within the submission package.

coordinates.description: Final adjusted coordinates [x, y] or [x, y, z] in the survey CRS (see LA_SpatialSource parent coordRefSys or the submission coordRefSys).

monumentation.description: Type of physical boundary monument for 'boundary' points (e.g. concreteMonument, ironPeg, naturalObject, unmarked).

accuracy.description: Positional accuracy of this point's adjusted coordinates.

registeredPoint.description: After cadastral acceptance: typed reference to the registered LA_Point created from this survey point. Absent at submission time.

note.description: Free-text note (e.g. 'neighbouring parcel corner, measured for context', 'GNSS base station')

SpatialAsset.description: A survey file or document asset. Inspired by the STAC Asset pattern.
